{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check value counts for key categorical variables
sex_counts = trial_df['sex'].value_counts()
arm_counts = trial_df['arm'].value_counts()
site_counts = trial_df['site'].value_counts()
severity_counts = trial_df['severity'].value_counts()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
baseline_desc = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].describe()
final_desc = trial_df['biomarker_final'].describe()

# Return all results
print(missing_values)
print(sex_counts)
print(arm_counts)
print(site_counts)
print(severity_counts)
print(duplicates)
print(baseline_desc)
print(final_desc)"}
